items.question: Does the referral link created for this retailer's referral program have an expiry date?
items.gold: No, the referral link does not have an expiry date.
items.fact: Referral link never expires, reused for every referral.

items.question: Which countries must a referrer reside in to take part in this retailer's referral program?
items.fact: Referrers must reside in UAE, KSA, BAH or India.
